description: An ordinary business payment reminder, not a notice
text:
Dear Sir/Madam,

Thank you for your recent order of 40 office chairs. This is a friendly reminder that invoice number INV-2026-118 for Rs. 64,000 is due for payment by the end of this month. Please let us know if you need a copy of the invoice or have any questions.

Warm regards,
Sample Furniture Co.
